Modules: imports and exports.

=== importing functions, classes, constants and types
-- script/util --
export const GREETING = "hi"
export function shout(s: string): string { return s.toUpperCase() + "!" }
export class Pair {
  a: number
  b: number
  constructor(a: number, b: number) { this.a = a; this.b = b }
  sum(): number { return this.a + this.b }
}
export interface Summable { sum(): number }
export type Count = number
-- script/main --
import { GREETING, shout, Pair, Summable, Count } from "script/util"
export function main(): string {
  const s: Summable = new Pair(1, 2)
  const n: Count = s.sum()
  return shout(GREETING) + str(n)
}
-- want --
"HI!3"

=== aliases and default exports
-- script/door --
export default class Door {
  open(): string { return "creak" }
}
export function knock(): string { return "knock" }
-- script/main --
import Door, { knock as rap } from "script/door"
export function main(): string { return rap() + " " + new Door().open() }
-- want --
"knock creak"

=== a module imported twice is one module
-- script/a --
import { base } from "script/base"
export function a(): number { return base() + 1 }
-- script/b --
import { base } from "script/base"
export function b(): number { return base() + 2 }
-- script/base --
export function base(): number { return 10 }
-- script/main --
import { a } from "script/a"
import { b } from "script/b"
export function main(): number { return a() + b() }
-- want --
23

=== classes extend classes of other modules
-- script/shape --
export class Shape {
  area(): number { return 0 }
  describe(): string { return "area " + str(this.area()) }
}
-- script/main --
import { Shape } from "script/shape"
class Square extends Shape {
  side = 3
  area(): number { return this.side * this.side }
}
export function main(): string { return new Square().describe() }
-- want --
"area 9"

=== only exports can be imported
-- script/util --
function hidden(): number { return 1 }
-- script/main --
import { hidden } from "script/util"
export function main(): number { return hidden() }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:10: script/util doesn't export hidden

=== import cycles are refused
-- script/a --
import { b } from "script/b"
export function a(): number { return 1 }
-- script/b --
import { a } from "script/a"
export function b(): number { return 1 }
-- script/main --
import { a } from "script/a"
export function main(): number { return a() }
-- compile error --
import cycle: script/a → script/b → script/a

=== unknown modules
-- script/main --
import { x } from "script/nowhere"
export function main(): number { return 1 }
-- compile error --
script/main:1:1: can't import "script/nowhere"

=== imports come first
-- script/util --
export const A = 1
-- script/main --
export const B = 2
import { A } from "script/util"
-- compile error --
imports come before everything else

=== names clash with imports
-- script/util --
export const A = 1
-- script/main --
import { A } from "script/util"
const A = 2
export function main(): number { return A }
-- compile error --
script/main:2:7: A is already declared

=== a module's errors name it
-- script/util --
export function f(): number { return "x" }
-- script/main --
import { f } from "script/util"
export function main(): number { return f() }
-- compile error --
script/util:1:38: f returns a number, not a string

=== the host's modules
-- script/main --
import { log } from "test"
export function main(): number {
  log("one")
  log("two")
  return 2
}
-- want --
2
-- logs --
one
two

=== host modules don't take natives from scripts
-- script/main --
export native function sneaky(): void
-- compile error --
only the host's modules declare native code
